title: Causes for Recent SOTA Students Food Poisoning Incident and Details of Shelf-life Product Testing under Food Resilience Preparedness Programme
what_it_is: Causes for Recent SOTA Students Food Poisoning Incident and Details of Shelf-life Product Testing under Food Resilience Preparedness Programme

sections.label: FRPP paused after SOTA gastroenteritis
sections.summary: The FRPP distributed over 100,000 RTE meals; after 20 SOTA students showed gastroenteritis symptoms, SFA, MOE, AIC and SATS paused it pending investigations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Food Resilience Preparedness Programme (FRPP) which involved the distribution of over 100,000 Ready-to-Eat (RTE) meals to secondary schools, pre-universities, Institutes of Technical Education, public agencies and Active Ageing Centres, was part of this year’s commemoration of Total Defence Day.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: On 19 February 2025, the Singapore Food Agency (SFA) was informed that 20 students at SOTA exhibited symptoms of gastroenteritis after they had consumed RTE meals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: On 20 February 2025, SFA, together with the Ministry of Education (MOE), Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) and food caterer SATS, decided to pause the FRPP until investigations on the SOTA gastroenteritis cases were concluded.

sections.label: Verified gastroenteritis case numbers
sections.summary: As of 3 March, 187 gastroenteritis cases were verified: 184 from schools, two from Active Ageing Centres and one from a public agency.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As of 3 March, the total number of verified cases of gastroenteritis was 187, of which 184 were from schools, two were from Active Ageing Centres and one from a public agency.

sections.label: No foodborne pathogens found
sections.summary: The tests did not find any foodborne pathogens.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The tests did not find any foodborne pathogens.

sections.label: SFA inspections and Food Safety Bill
sections.summary: SFA conducts regular inspections, and the Food Safety and Security Bill enhanced the food safety framework from importation to retail.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: On the first questions about inspection and food safety, indeed, SFA conducts regular inspections.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We have also, through the enactment of the Food Safety and Security Bill (FSSB) recently, enhanced the framework of ensuring food safety across all stages of supply of food – from importation to wholesaling to preparation to retail.

sections.label: RTE premises inspection and samples
sections.summary: Premises were inspected before the FRPP with satisfactory outcome, and no food-borne pathogens were detected in RTE meal samples.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As to the RTE process, I have mentioned in my answer earlier on, we have inspected the premises before the FRPP and are satisfied with the outcome of the inspection.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Also, as of today, our results have shown that there were no food-borne pathogens detected in the samples of the RTE meals.

sections.label: FSSB licensing transparency regime
sections.summary: Under the FSSB, a new regime will license food establishments according to their readiness and systems in place.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: On transparency, again, in the FSSB, there will be a new regime to ensure that our food establishments are licensed according to their readiness, according to the system that they have put in place.

sections.label: Programme suspension
sections.summary: The programme has been suspended in the meantime.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: In the meantime, we have suspended this programme.

sections.label: Next programme roll-out
sections.summary: They will learn from it and roll out the programme in due course and in full readiness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We are expected to learn from it and be better.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, we will do it in due course and in full readiness before our next roll-out of the programme.
